title: Card - Post
description: Flat blog post card shell — no banner/image zone (unlike Card - Case Study, whose radius/blockGap/border-mix values this was checked against and found genuinely different: 300/16px vs this card's 400/24px, and blockGap:0 for a banner layout vs this card's real blockGap since content isn't split into separate zones). Radius matches Card - Highlight Dark so both new Blog Archive card shells read as one family.
